concerns.text: FR-002 requires ingesting satellite thermal data (MODIS/Landsat) for the most recent 5-year period. The plan.md 'Research' section (1.1) and 'Dataset Strategy Table' explicitly state 'NO VERIFIED SOURCE' for LST data and note the provided verified block contains only speech datasets. The plan acknowledges the pipeline will 'fail at the data ingestion step' without a verified URL. This is a silent under-planning of a core Functional Requirement; the implementer has no task to satisfy FR-002 because the data source is missing from the verified block.

FR-001 requires ingesting raw vector data from OpenStreetMap (OSM). The plan.md 'Research' section (1.1) and 'Dataset Strategy Table' explicitly state 'NO VERIFIED SOURCE' for OSM data. The plan admits the implementation will fail to fetch this data. There is no corresponding plan element (phase, contract, or task) to resolve this data availability gap, leaving FR-001 unbacked.

FR-010 requires calculating the 'Unexplained Variance Gap' by comparing observed R² against literature-derived upper bounds. The plan.md 'Research' section (2.1) mentions this will be calculated, but the 'Dataset Strategy' and 'Verified Datasets' sections indicate the project cannot run to generate 'observed R²' due to missing data sources (FR-001/FR-002). Without a plan to resolve the data gap, the metric required by FR-010 cannot be computed, rendering the requirement untestable in the current plan.
